about: Commits allowed to reach a protected branch (main/master) without a PR. Read by main-watch (CI), the global git pre-push hook, and the Claude Code push guard. Found 2026-09-22 by reading every repo's scripts, workflows, timers and garage deploy units. A rule matches when the commit subject matches `subject` (Python regex), the branch matches `branch` (if set), and every changed file matches `paths` (if set). Keep rules narrow: subject AND paths wherever the automation's file set is known.

drench44/family-hub.name: release script (scripts/release.py, pushed by hand with git push --follow-tags)
drench44/family-hub.subject: ^release: v\d+\.\d+\.\d+$
